text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Onto the straightaway! Are they still 
holding back energy on the inside!? Glory 
in the Takarazuka Kinen is just ahead!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
('The strongest idiot is cool,' huh? When 
you really think about it, isn't that 
crazy? Sounds like a joke.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Still, hearing him say that to me... kind 
of made me feel like I could actually do 
it.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (I'm seriously so simple. But—)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Because that seems to be my strength. 
Because there are people who tell me that 
I can do it!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Let's go crazy with this, then!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaah~... Phew~...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Did she pry open the door through sheer 
tenacity?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Never mind that. After having that shown 
to me not just once, but twice... well.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. That's what makes competing so 
fun. You never know what'll happen... and 
that's the best part.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, Jordan. What are you gonna pull next?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? But I'm—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm aiming for the world stage. No matter 
how slim the odds are, it just sounds way 
more fun that way.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The world? Isn't that taking things a 
bit too far out of nowhere?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"See? There's a dream in it, right? ...And 
so,"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Just as that is the path I walk, there 
must be a path that only you can take."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Coming from you, who's overturned the 
board time and time again, it's gotta be 
something so big that no one... not even I 
could predict it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As a spectator, I'm looking forward to it. 
...To the kind of race only you can pull 
off.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(My goal is to "become the ultimate 
fool.")

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(That's why I challenged Golshi. To 
surpass her.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, if I'm aiming to be the 
strongest, might as well go all out...!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "...Hey, Trainer. Will you listen to me?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna become the strongest, right? In 
that case—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I want to become faster than any other 
Umamusume out there.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Not just faster than my current rivals, ya 
know? I wanna be faster than those 
historical legends, too. Like, to the 
point where I become the textbook itself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's like, I wanna do something crazy 
big...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Laugh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Do you think I'm being stupid?
choice_data_list:
I think it's great precisely because it's 
so ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list:
Let's be bigger and wilder than anyone 
else!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I think over the races where that could 
be achieved with Tosen Jordan."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If we're going big anyway, it ought to be 
on a prestigious stage that draws 
everyone's attention."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And she must show a "speed" that will be 
etched into Umamusume history. At the 
distance where her legs truly come alive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...The Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RAT-TAT-TAT-TAT!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody called, but here comes 
Golshi-chan! Ta-da-da-daaah☆"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: !? Golshi!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, what're you talking about? About 
the granny at the local seaweed shop 
having a half-off sale?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hey, Golshi. I'm running in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So you've gotta compete against me 
there...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ? What're you talkin' about?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't no dish called 'Aki-Ten' on the 
Golshi Diner menu! Go bring a cuckoo and 
try again!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh, but up until now...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Because that's not my race, is it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...If it's your race, hold your head high 
and give it all you've got.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Jordan's gonna become the ultimate idiot!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho~ That sounds fun. Maybe I'll go hawk 
some fried yakisoba to the spectators.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, time to stock up! 
Guess I'll head out on some deep-sea 
fishing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: See ya, Jordan. Here, take this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Notice to Staff"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Any doors broken by Gold Ship from now on 
will be repaired by Tosen Jordan and her 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wha—Golshi!? What is the meaning of 
this~?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Those are the notices I'm handing out to 
everyone! I'll leave the rest to you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were things I gained from 
associating with Gold Ship. And while 
there were also plenty of useless things I 
wish I hadn't...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan's next goal was set. Up next 
was the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
